name: Nakadashi Haramase Shin'yaku Chousa
original_name: 中出し孕ませ新薬調査
source:
*Drink, F*ck, Pregnancy Experiments Gone Awry*

A doctor (protagonist) is developing a fertility drug to
reverse the declining birth rate. At the same time, he's perfecting a
devious aphrodisiac. When these two get mixed up, it's sexual
pandemonium in the lab!

- Three HOT heroines (plus one extra!)
Hikari the nurse from childhood, Chiu with brother complex,
Mio the sensuous female doctor... who will you "experiment" with? 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE081728.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
＊服药、做爱，受孕实验彻底失控＊

主人公是一名医生，正在研发扭转少子化趋势的促孕药，同时也在改良一种阴险的催情剂。两种药物意外混在一起，实验室顿时陷入性爱大混乱！

－三名火辣女主角（外加一名隐藏角色！）
青梅竹马护士朝比奈ひかり、有恋兄情结的折原千忧、性感女医生神谷澪……你想拿谁做“实验”？
